review_provenance: AI-assisted post-hoc inspection of synthetic raw text plus deterministic count reconciliation; no human semantic judgment or independent rater.

observed_measurement_failures.finding: All 19 responses clearly recommend one current option and mention the other only in a comparison, but the frozen whole-response occurrence rule assigns UNRESOLVED.
Five single-current-option replies give a supported present-note reason, but the frozen literal cues assign UNRESOLVED.

Both replies lead with the archived entity 'express shuttle', which is not a current option. A generic current alias appearing later in comparison text makes the frozen scorer falsely assign current Option A.
observed_measurement_failures.scientific_signal: Exact-string evidence of history-to-current response-plan/entity-binding intrusion in one conflicting case and two S/F configurations.
observed_measurement_failures.causal_limit: The mechanism label is post-hoc and the two records share one case; independent cases are required.

factorial_interpretation.reason: The deterministic scorer has outcome-dependent false unresolved and false current-choice classifications affecting 26 disjoint records in total.
factorial_interpretation.surface_style_only: The frozen S main contrast for the literal linguistic conjunction is +0.50, but it is heterogeneous (PF_B 2/12 versus PF_C 10/12 among S-present cells) and is not general Persona Fidelity. The literal behavioral conjunction is 6/24 in S-present and 0/24 in S-absent cells.

independent_validation_v1.reason: Its explicit prerequisite requires alias/cue integrity and scorer-behavior audit PASS. Those requirements failed on development data.

next_action: Use untouched, pre-output-frozen synthetic cases in a separately registered adaptive mechanism validation whose primary endpoint parses the leading recommendation target and explicitly detects non-current archived targets. Retain the failed occurrence scorer only as a historical secondary endpoint.
